text:
alex: Quick async check — Q2 shipcheck: short update please. What actually shipped, what slipped, blockers, and who owns follow-ups. Trying to wrap product OKR rollup by EOD PST. Ping owners.

marta: Ship: runtime-v2 canary rolled to 60% yesterday (PR #4123) :tada:. Metrics look good. Remaining: docs & console banner. Owner: marta.

devon: Slipped: dedicated-scaling autoscaler work. Blocked on infra quota change from cloud. ETA moved to next sprint. Owner: devon. @samir can you confirm cloud quota ETA?

samir: Confirming infra quota request in progress. Cloud team says tentative change Wed 3/25. If it holds, devon's can resume. Also raising that we need a migration window for warm cache invalidation.

lee: Code review pings: left comments on PRs:
- runtime-v2: #4123 — minor nits, approved after patch
- autoscaler: #4189 — request for test coverage, blocking merge
Please address asap, ci showing flakey test in `batcher_test.go`.

ci-bot: build/PR #4189 status: failed — flakey test `TestBatchTimeout`. Re-run queued.

marta: I'll take the docs banner in the morning and ship today. @alex can we do a small marketing callout for the canary? want visibility in the release notes.

alex: Yes, please craft a one-paragraph summary. Also devon, set an explicit owner for autoscaler follow-up and add a short rollback plan in the PR. Let me know if you need an escrow branch.

devon: Assigned owner = devon + lee (for CR). Will add rollback steps and a short QA checklist by EOD. ETA if quota holds: 3/25 - merge + smoke.

samir: Noted, planning migration window Thu 3/26 02:00–03:00 UTC. I'll add to infra calendar and tag SRE.

lee: I'll fix the flakey test today and push patch. @devon once green I'll re-review.

alex: OK thanks everyone. Short asks:
- marta: marketing blurb by 11am PT
- devon: rollback + QA checklist by EOD
- lee: test fix + re-review within 6h
- samir: confirm quota row by EOD

If anything slips after these, call it out here. :thumbsup: 

marta: Will do. :white_check_mark:

devon: On it.

lee: Patch pushed, test rerun queued. linking PR: https://git.internal/r/4189

ci-bot: build/PR #4189 status: success — all checks passed. :rocket:

alex: Great — adding this to the OKR rollup doc. Thanks all.
